resources.string: Choose what this phone is for. You can change it any time.
Hold a credential on this phone and prove your glasses are present.
Enroll glasses and check who walks up.
Connect to the Meta AI app
Disconnect from the Meta AI app
GlassesGate reaches your glasses through the Meta AI app. It only ever asks whether a session is open — it never sees the camera, the microphone, or anything you look at.
None yet. Ask an admin to add your glasses, then scan the code they show you.
Broadcast while my glasses are on
Claim an enrollment before you can broadcast.
The beacon only transmits while your glasses are actually connected. Fold them, take them off, or walk out of range and it stops within seconds.
That isn\'t a GlassesGate enrollment code.
That code has expired. Ask the admin to generate a fresh one.
Connect your glasses in the Meta AI app first, then scan the code again.
More than one pair of glasses is connected. Disconnect the others so the credential binds to the right pair.
This phone has already claimed that code.
Add at least one pair of glasses before opening the gate.
Not seen at this gate yet
Record which pair this is, then show the code to whoever wears them.
Printed inside the temple arm. Used to tell pairs apart — it isn\'t what grants access.
Shown on the gate screen when they walk up.
Optional. Helps the wearer tell one enrollment from another.
Have the wearer scan this with GlassesGate while their glasses are connected.
Treat this like a key. Until it expires in ten minutes, whoever scans it first gets the credential — including someone photographing it over your shoulder. Revoke and re-issue if you\'re unsure.
The code is gone. It\'s deliberately not kept across a rotation. Revoke the entry and issue a new one.
Shown while your glasses are acting as a credential.
Paused — put your glasses back on.
A different pair of glasses is connected.
GlassesGate needs the Nearby devices permission to broadcast.
GlassesGate needs the Nearby devices permission to watch for approved glasses.
GlassesGate needs the camera to read an enrollment code.
